payload.title: CYRQODE: birth of the technology
payload.author: Rashid Kabzhanov
payload.summary: First record of the CYRQODE journal. On this day the technology got its name, its symbol and its written specifications: the BUIP protocol, the Circle Mark physical sign, and the encoder-scanner-decoder chain. This entry exists to be the first thing the technology ever proved: its own beginning.

naming.BUIP: protocol of identity, events and proofs
naming.Circle Mark: physical sign carrying a stable entity identifier

payload.note: This mark carries only the identifier. The name, the date and this text live here, in the record, not in the mark. That separation is the point: the mark stays valid forever, the record can be extended, and personal data never enters the journal.

payload.documents_note: Only the hashes are part of the record. The documents themselves stay with their owner: the journal proves that a document with this exact content existed on this date, without holding the document.
